summary: Vertical Aerospace filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt, on September 9, 2026, of NYSE notice that its ordinary shares traded below $1.00 on average over a consecutive 30 trading-day period, failing Section 802.01C of the NYSE Listed Company Manual. The foreign private issuer (UK-domiciled) notified the exchange of its intent to cure and stay listed. A six-month cure period applies; compliance returns if, on any month-end, closing price and 30-day average closing price both reach at least $1.00. A press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. Watch reverse-split timing, dilution risk, and delisting-driven volatility.
